For the if-else chain here, any coordinate being negligible suggests that the other two are both active considering the block it's in, so I think this (and the changes I proposed for 3091 and 3106) can help simplify these checks without altering their functionality in any way. The Math::abs check was removed here (and on those other two checks) for similar reasoning to the suggestion for lines 2993-3007.

>  perhaps an alternative would be setting delta's coordinates to their absolute values and then removing all future Math::abs calls involving it.

Alternative makes sense to me, so this was implemented.
if this is a refcounted use the .instantiate() method.

if this is a refcounted use don't remove the reference pointer by casting.
